risk_summary: The excerpt discloses materially adverse conditions, including recurring operating losses, rising default interest expense, substantial related-party borrowings, and continued reliance on advances to fund operations. Liquidity and debt-servicing risk appear elevated, while management offsets these concerns with qualitative expectations about San Francisco recovery and future hotel performance. Some liquidity discussion is truncated and several forward-looking assessments rely on subjective assumptions rather than quantified forecasts.
